frame: x east, y north, cm, z up (the map frame; Unreal x and y alike)
note: One row per legal curb space on the replica streets. x, y: the car centre (cm); z: the road top; yaw: the car heading (degrees, the C++ curb-parking facing: a one-way street faces its traffic, a two-way street faces +direction on its left (OSM sense) side); length: the length class (0 coupe 600 cm, 1 sedan 625 cm, 2 wagon 650 cm centre to centre); paint: AQuebecCar PaintStyle 0..3; body: BodyProfile 0..2, the Car70Body mesh (all 466 cm long, 220 cm over the mirrors); street, way, side (L or R, OSM sense); traffic_segment: the C++ LaFontaine::RoadSegments index or -1; curb_cm: mirror to curb. The game puts the pivot 100.5 cm over the road. The preview draws these; the game fills them at runtime.
